title: Summarize Student 2's Enrollment Snapshot
instruction: Using only the enrollment records already retrieved for Student 2, write a one-paragraph summary of the student's current course load (active vs completed vs dropped).
why_plan_and_solve: Single deterministic synthesis over already-fetched facts. No competing orderings to weigh and no high-stakes decision ships from this step, so a one-pass Plan-and-Solve chain is the cheapest method that fits.
